experiments.summary: Five-seed temporal binding benchmark; substrate mean accuracy was slightly below the mean baseline despite valid sparse spiking.
Local fast-synapse adaptation reduced held-out query MSE from 4.4851 to 4.2293 (~5.7%).
V13 improved family routing 0.80 -> 0.9333 while verified rate remained 0.0; host wall time increased ~2.9x and parameter count ~31.4%.
Deeper neural backends improved short family-routing accuracy but did not improve verified execution.
